<!-- pr-reviewer: 34117a1ef22242500c7aaf931f098ad7d9026278 -->
**Verdict: read, not built - needs a maintainer look.**

What the PR does:
- Removes `drop(point);` at `crates/app/tests/import_step_thread.rs:133`.
- The closure does not implement `Drop`. Clippy 0.1.98 flags the call
  (`drop_non_drop`). The borrow analysis ends the borrow at the last use,
  so the removal is correct. This is the fix owed by #2794.

Review method:
- Read-only review. I merged nothing and built nothing.
- The head `34117a1ef` does not conflict with `main` (GitHub says
  MERGEABLE). `main` still has the line at :133 with the same context, so
  the merge keeps both changes.

Why it was not built:
- The PR author is not a collaborator. The self-hosted test runner refuses
  code from a fork by rule, and no local build was authorized for this
  review. "Not run" is never a pass, so the result is a read, not a gate.

What a maintainer must do before merge:
- The branch predates the solidcore STEP switch (`a4f1d9cb6`, `a3462d020`,
  `48071efd4`). Those commits changed this same file after the PR base.
  The merged tree is not what the author tested. Run a gate on the merged
  tree before the merge, and say so here.

Project rules checked: the change is in a test file only; no behaviour
change; no changelog row needed; commit subject `test(app): ...` is the
correct form.
